# nautobot_tenant_group (Resource)

Manages a tenant group in Nautobot.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nautobot_tenant_group" "new" {
  name        = "New Tenant Group"
  description = "Created with Terraform"
}

output "resource_tenant_group" {
  value = nautobot_tenant_group.new
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Tenant group's name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Tenant group's description.
- `parent_id` (String) UUID of the parent tenant group.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Tenant group's creation date (RFC3339).
- `id` (String) Tenant group's UUID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/usr/bin/env sh
# A tenant group can be imported using its unique ID, e.g. '748ca2dd-a3ac-5bb6-8b4a-276b7e3c33c7'
terraform import nautobot_tenant_group.example "748ca2dd-a3ac-5bb6-8b4a-276b7e3c33c7"
```
